topic: The positive and negative adjacency inertia of Bell-type Riordan graphs
title: Extending Mwafise's cycle example to answer Cheon–Jung–Kitaev–Mojallal's Bell-type Riordan inertia question

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Extending Mwafise's five-cycle example (26 October 2026, v1.0.0, README §4.4), we answer Problem 6.11 of Cheon, Jung, Kitaev and Mojallal, Riordan graphs II: Spectral properties, arXiv:1801.07021v1 (2018), p. 25, negatively: G_5(1+z^3,z(1+z^3)) is C_5 with inertia (3,2,0). The construction G_n(1+z^{n-2},z(1+z^{n-2}))=C_n yields counterexamples at every order 4q+1>=5. We prove minimality among all simple graphs, extend their even-series criterion to a finite-prefix characterization of bipartiteness for proper Bell-type graphs, and show that their absolute inertia bound is sharp at every order n>=2.
summary: Mwafise's earlier five-cycle example yields a Bell-type graph with inertia (3,2,0), answering the inertia question negatively. The note extends it to all cycle orders and proves minimality, a proper finite-prefix bipartiteness criterion, sharpness of the source's absolute inertia bound, and an equal-inertia nonbipartite example. The linked Lean declaration covers the five-vertex coefficient identity and inertia; the other results have written proofs and exact finite checks.
